svg.text: Introit, Kyrie, Gloria and Collect · LM-018A–LM-028B · spoken 1962 Low Mass, two servers

g.text: The Introit: the priest signs himself at the Missal
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · L on-breast / R
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
priest: standing · predella-epistle-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · joined-before-breast
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing
UNRESOLVED: The approved record fixes the left-hand-on-breast detail explicitly for the priest
only; for the servers it settles only that both of them sign themselves.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
“Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto. Sicut erat in principio, et nunc,
et semper, et in saecula saeculorum. Amen.” (audible)
priest: standing · bow head-moderate · predella-epistle-corner · faces altar-cross · eyes cross
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: The approved record says only that the priest 'bows toward the cross' at the Introit
doxology and does not fix the depth of that bow; head-moderate is drawn here.

Gloria in excelsis: the opening gesture
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · elevated
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-GLORIA-01, INV-MISSAL-01,
priest: standing · bow head-moderate · predella-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross ·
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: The approved record prescribes a bow at 'Deo' without fixing its depth;
head-moderate is drawn here, and the profound head bows the record does name are recorded at
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-GLORIA-01, INV-MISSAL-01,
Gloria in excelsis: the prescribed bows
priest: standing · bow head-profound · predella-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross ·
AC1: kneeling · bow head-moderate · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
AC2: kneeling · bow head-moderate · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes downcast ·
UNRESOLVED: The approved record prescribes profound head bows 'at the relevant phrases' of the
Gloria in excelsis but does not enumerate which phrases they are.
UNRESOLVED: The depth of the servers' corresponding bow is not fixed by the approved record; a
moderate head bow is drawn here.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-GLORIA-01, INV-MISSAL-01,
Cum Sancto Spiritu: all three sign themselves
“Cum Sancto Spiritu, in gloria Dei Patris. Amen.” (audible)
priest: standing · predella-centre · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing
AC1: kneeling · step-1-epistle · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing
AC2: kneeling · step-1-gospel · faces altar-cross · eyes cross · L on-breast / R signing
UNRESOLVED: The approved record fixes the left-hand-on-breast detail explicitly at the Introit
only; here it settles that the priest and both servers all sign themselves.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-GLORIA-01, INV-MISSAL-01,
